roots.origin: 拉丁语 putare（修剪，引申为清点、估算）；computare（com＋putare 合起来算）经古法语 conter 派出 count 一支
roots.core_concept: reckoning a thing up to settle what it comes to / 把东西点算一遍，定出它算多少
roots.core_image: 手指点着桌上的钱一枚枚过，嘴里跟着报数

roots.origin: 拉丁语 fallere（使跌倒、骗过），过去分词 falsus；本义是脚下一空、人没接住，故「失手」与「假的」出自同一意象
roots.core_concept: the footing giving way so the thing does not hold / 脚下一空，事没托住
roots.core_image: 踩上去那块板忽然塌下去，手里的东西一起掉了

roots.origin: 拉丁语 densus（稠的、挤实的），动词 densare 表「使变稠」
roots.core_concept: packed so tight there is no gap left / 挤得实实的，没留缝
roots.core_image: 一把棉花被手攥紧，攥到指缝里再挤不出空气

roots.origin: 拉丁语 discus（圆盘、掷饼）← 希腊语 diskos；扁圆一片这个形状，派出盘子、圆片、桌板三支
roots.core_concept: a flat round thing you set things on or throw / 扁圆的一片，用来盛放或掷出
roots.core_image: 一块扁圆的板，边上一圈微微翘起

roots.origin: 希腊语 phainein（使显现、露出来）；phasis 表「显出的相」，phantasia 表「心里现出的影」，英语 fantasy、fancy 同出后者
roots.core_concept: bringing a thing into sight so it shows / 让某样东西现出来、被看见
roots.core_image: 帘子一拉开，原先看不见的那样东西露在光里

roots.origin: 拉丁语 fatum（神所说定的事）← fari（说）的过去分词中性形；Fata（司命三女神）经古法语 fae 派出 fairy 一支
roots.core_concept: what was spoken once and cannot be taken back / 一旦说定就收不回的那件事
roots.core_image: 一句话说出口，纸上就照那句写下，谁也改不动
roots.english_definition: that which has been spoken, destiny

concepts.concept: reckoning a thing up to settle what it comes to
concepts.core_image: 手指点着桌上的钱一枚枚过，嘴里跟着报数

concepts.concept: the footing giving way so the thing does not hold
concepts.core_image: 踩上去那块板忽然塌下去，手里的东西一起掉了

concepts.concept: packed so tight there is no gap left
concepts.core_image: 一把棉花被攥紧，攥到指缝里再挤不出空气

concepts.concept: a flat round thing you set things on or throw
concepts.core_image: 一块扁圆的板，边上一圈微微翘起

concepts.concept: bringing a thing into sight so it shows
concepts.core_image: 帘子一拉开，原先看不见的那样东西露在光里

concepts.concept: what was spoken once and cannot be taken back
concepts.core_image: 一句话说出口，纸上就照那句写下，谁也改不动

words.root_logic: com-（合起来）+ put（算）→ computare（合算）经古法语 conter → 一个个点过
words.origin: 古法语 conter ← 拉丁语 computare（合算）← com＋putare（清点）
words.native_definition: to say numbers in order; to find the total of things
words.core_concept: going over items one by one so none is passed twice – 一件件点过去，不重不漏
words.core_image: 他指着一排箱子挨个点，点到哪儿手就停在哪儿
semantic_expansions: 数/计数：一件件点过去定出总数
算作：把某物点进这一类里
words.recall_hint: com-（合起来）+ put（算）→ 一个个点过

words.root_logic: com-（合起来）+ pute（算）→ 把各项合起来算出结果
words.origin: 拉丁语 computare（合算）← com＋putare（清点、估算）
words.native_definition: to calculate an answer using numbers
words.core_concept: putting all the parts together to get one figure – 把各项合到一处，算出一个数
words.core_image: 各栏数字挨着加下来，最后一格填出总数
examples: He computed the cost in minutes.
semantic_expansions: 计算/算出：把各项合起来得出一个数
words.recall_hint: com-（合起来）+ pute（算）→ 合起来算出结果

words.root_logic: dis-（去掉）+ count（算）→ 从原数里算掉一部分 → 折扣
words.origin: 古法语 desconter（扣除）← dis＋conter ← 拉丁语 computare
words.native_definition: an amount taken off the usual price; to treat as unimportant
words.core_concept: the part struck off the total before you pay – 付钱之前从总数里划掉的那一截
words.core_image: 标价被笔划掉，旁边写了个小些的数
examples: They offered a ten percent discount.
semantic_expansions: 折扣/打折：从总数里算掉的那一截
不予考虑：把某说法从考量里划掉
words.recall_hint: dis-（去掉）+ count（算）→ 从原数里算掉一部分

words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ pute（算）→ 各算各的、算不到一处 → 争执
words.origin: 古法语 desputer ← 拉丁语 disputare（各自估算、辩论）← dis＋putare
words.native_definition: a disagreement or argument between sides
words.core_concept: two reckonings that will not come out the same – 两边各算一遍，算出来的数对不上
words.core_image: 两人各拿一张纸算同一笔账，末了数字差着一截
semantic_expansions: 争执/争论：各算各的、算不到一处
质疑：不认对方那笔算法
words.recall_hint: dis-（分开）+ pute（算）→ 各算各的、对不上

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ put（派定）→ 被指派下来顶事的人 → 副职
words.origin: 古法语 deputé ← 晚期拉丁语 deputare（指派）← de＋putare（估定、派定）
words.native_definition: a person given authority to act for someone else
words.core_concept: the one named to stand in when the first is away – 被点定、正主不在时顶上的那个
words.core_image: 名册上头一个名字底下写着第二个，正主不在就他签字
examples: The deputy signed in her absence.
He was elected deputy last year.
semantic_expansions: 副手/代理人：被点定、正主不在时顶上的那个
议员：受选派代表一方的那个
words.recall_hint: de-（往下）+ put（派定）→ 被指派顶事的人

words.root_logic: fallere（使跌倒）→ 该托住的没托住 → 没做成
words.origin: 古法语 faillir ← 通俗拉丁语 fallire ← 拉丁语 fallere（使跌倒、骗过）
words.native_definition: to not succeed in doing something; to stop working
words.core_concept: the moment the thing that should have held gives out – 本该托住的那一下没托住
words.core_image: 绳子在半空断了，吊着的东西直接落到地上
examples: The engine failed on the hill.
semantic_expansions: 失败/不及格：该成的没成
失灵：该运转的忽然不动了
words.recall_hint: fallere（使跌倒）→ 该托住的没托住

words.root_logic: fail（没做成）+ -ure → 没做成这件事，或没做成的那个人/物
words.origin: 英语 failure，来自 fail ← 拉丁语 fallere
words.native_definition: a lack of success; a person or thing that does not work
words.core_concept: what is left after the footing gave way – 塌下去之后剩下的那个局面
words.core_image: 地上一堆碎的，旁边立着那截断了的绳
examples: A power failure hit the town.
semantic_expansions: 失败：没做成这件事
故障：机件该动而不动那一下
失败者：屡屡没成的那个人
words.recall_hint: fail（没做成）+ -ure → 没做成的局面

words.root_logic: falsus（fallere 的过去分词）→ 骗过人的 → 假的、不实的
words.origin: 拉丁语 falsus（假的、骗人的），fallere（骗过）的过去分词
words.native_definition: not true or real; intended to deceive
words.core_concept: the thing that looks sound until your weight is on it – 看着结实，一压上去才知道不是
words.core_image: 那块板漆得跟别处一样，踩上去才发现底下是空的
semantic_expansions: 错误的：与实际不符
假的：造出来冒充真的
虚伪的：待人时装出的那副样子
words.recall_hint: falsus（fallere 的过去分词）→ 骗过人的、假的

words.root_logic: fallere（失手）→ 出岔的那一处 → 过失、缺陷
words.origin: 古法语 faute ← 通俗拉丁语 fallita（失手之处）← 拉丁语 fallere
words.native_definition: a mistake or weakness; responsibility for something wrong
words.core_concept: the one spot where it gave way, and whose hand let it – 塌掉的那一处，以及那是谁的手松了
words.core_image: 查下来是那一颗螺丝没拧紧，别处都好
examples: The machine has a design fault.
semantic_expansions: 过失：出岔那一下该谁负责
缺点/故障：物件上出岔的那一处
words.recall_hint: fallere（失手）→ 出岔的那一处

words.root_logic: fault（出岔之处）+ -y → 带着毛病的
words.origin: 英语 faulty，来自 fault ← 拉丁语 fallere
words.native_definition: not working properly because of a defect
words.core_concept: of the kind that will give way somewhere – 属于「总有一处会塌」的那种
words.core_image: 同一批插头里有几个一插就跳闸，别的都正常
examples: The faulty wiring caused the fire.
semantic_expansions: 有缺陷的/有故障的：带着毛病、总有一处会塌的那种
words.recall_hint: fault（出岔之处）+ -y → 带着毛病的

words.root_logic: densus（稠的）→ 单位地方里挤了很多 → 密集的
words.origin: 拉丁语 densus（稠密的、挤实的）
words.native_definition: having parts packed closely together; hard to see through
words.core_concept: so much crowded into one space that little else fits – 一处地方里挤了太多，别的塞不进
words.core_image: 树干挨着树干，走进去几步就看不见来路
examples: The forest is very dense here.
semantic_expansions: 密集的/浓密的：一处地方里挤了很多
愚钝的：脑子像塞满了，转不动
words.recall_hint: densus（稠的）→ 一处地方里挤了很多

words.root_logic: dense（密集的）+ -ity → 挤得多密这个量
words.origin: 拉丁语 densitas（稠密）← densus
words.native_definition: how tightly packed something is; mass per unit of volume
words.core_concept: the measure of how much is crowded into one space – 一处地方里究竟挤了多少的那个量
words.core_image: 同样大的两只盒子，一只沉手一只轻，装的东西疏密不同
examples: The city has high population density.
semantic_expansions: 密度/稠密度：一处地方里挤了多少的那个量
words.recall_hint: dense（密集的）+ -ity → 挤得多密这个量

words.root_logic: con-（一起）+ dense（挤实）→ 往一处挤紧 → 压缩、凝结
words.origin: 拉丁语 condensare（使变稠）← con＋densare ← densus（稠的）
words.native_definition: to make something smaller or shorter; to change from gas to liquid
words.core_concept: squeezing what was spread out into one tighter mass – 把摊开的往一处挤成更紧的一团
words.core_image: 满满一锅汤熬到只剩碗底那点，味道全收在里头
examples: He condensed the report to one page.
semantic_expansions: 压缩/浓缩：把摊开的往一处挤紧
凝结：气挤成液那一下
words.recall_hint: con-（一起）+ dense（挤实）→ 往一处挤紧

words.root_logic: discus（圆盘）→ 扁而圆的那一片
words.origin: 拉丁语 discus（圆盘）← 希腊语 diskos（掷饼）
words.native_definition: a thin flat round object
words.core_concept: the thin round piece you can spin between two fingers – 两指一夹就能转起来的那薄薄一圆片
words.core_image: 薄薄一片圆的，对着光能看见一圈圈细纹
examples: He put the disc in the player.
She slipped a disc in her back.
semantic_expansions: 圆盘：扁而圆的那一片
唱片：刻了纹的那种圆片
椎间盘：脊椎间垫着的那片圆软骨
words.recall_hint: discus（圆盘）→ 扁而圆的那一片

words.root_logic: discus（圆盘）经古英语 disc → 盛食物的那只浅圆器
words.origin: 古英语 disc（盘）← 拉丁语 discus（圆盘）← 希腊语 diskos
words.native_definition: a shallow container for food; food prepared in a particular way
words.core_concept: the shallow round thing food is set into – 把菜放进去的那只浅圆器
words.core_image: 浅浅一只圆的，菜盛在里头边上还留一圈
examples: This dish takes an hour to cook.
semantic_expansions: 盘子：盛食物的那只浅圆器
菜/一道菜：装在那只器里端上来的那样吃食
words.recall_hint: discus（圆盘）→ 盛食物的浅圆器

words.root_logic: discus（圆盘、板）经中世纪拉丁语 desca → 写字用的那块板 → 书桌
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 desca（桌）← 拉丁语 discus（圆盘、扁板）
words.native_definition: a piece of furniture with a flat top for writing or working
words.core_concept: the flat board set at hand height to work on – 架到手边高度、供人在上头做事的那块平板
words.core_image: 一块平板架在两侧支架上，胳膊搭上去正好
semantic_expansions: 书桌/办公桌：架到手边、供人做事的那块平板
服务台：同样一块板，隔在办事人与客人之间
words.recall_hint: discus（扁板）→ desca → 写字用的那块板

words.root_logic: em-（en- 在内）+ phas（显现）+ -is → 把某一处特意显出来 → 强调
words.origin: 希腊语 emphasis（显露、着重）← en＋phainein（使显现）
words.native_definition: special importance given to something in speaking or writing
words.core_concept: the one part pushed forward so the eye goes there first – 特意推到前头、让人先看见的那一处
words.core_image: 整段话里只有那一句被放慢了，听的人都记住了它
examples: The emphasis falls on the first syllable.
semantic_expansions: 强调/重点：特意显出来、让人先看见的那一处
重音：读音上被显出来的那一节
words.recall_hint: em-（在内）+ phas（显现）→ 特意把一处显出来

words.root_logic: phantasia（心里现出的影）← phainein（使显现）→ 只在心里显出、不在眼前的那些
words.origin: 古法语 fantasie ← 拉丁语 phantasia ← 希腊语 phantasia（想象）← phainein
words.native_definition: something imagined that is not real; a story of magical events
words.core_concept: the picture that shows only inside the head – 只在脑子里现出来、外头没有的那幅
words.core_image: 闭上眼那幅景象清清楚楚，睁眼什么也没有
examples: He lives in a fantasy world.
semantic_expansions: 幻想/想象：只在脑子里现出来的那幅
奇幻作品：把这类景象写成的故事
words.recall_hint: phantasia（心里现出的影）→ 只在心里显出的那些

words.root_logic: fantasy 的截短形 → 心里现出个念头 → 觉得想要、喜欢；形容词指花哨
words.origin: 中古英语 fantsy，fantasy 的截短 ← 希腊语 phantasia ← phainein
words.native_definition: to want or like something; elaborately decorated
words.core_concept: the notion that surfaces on its own, unbidden – 没人叫它、自己在心里冒出来的那个念头
words.core_image: 橱窗前站了一会儿，脚就是不肯往前挪
examples: Do you fancy a cup of tea?
semantic_expansions: 想要/喜欢：心里自己冒出来的那个念头
花哨的：外表现得过多、招眼的那种
words.recall_hint: fantasy 截短 → 心里自己冒出的念头

words.root_logic: fatum（所说定之事）→ 由不得人改的那个去向
words.origin: 拉丁语 fatum（命定之事）← fari（说）的过去分词
words.native_definition: the power thought to decide events; what finally happens to someone
words.core_concept: the outcome already spoken, whatever one does – 早已说定的那个结果，人怎么动都一样
words.core_image: 签抽出来了，上面写着什么就照着走，重抽也没用
examples: The fate of the ship is unknown.
semantic_expansions: 命运：由不得人改的那个去向
结局/下场：那个去向最后落成的样子
words.recall_hint: fatum（所说定之事）→ 由不得人改的去向

words.root_logic: fatum（定数）+ -al → 关乎定数的 → 致命的、决定性的
words.origin: 拉丁语 fatalis（命定的、致死的）← fatum
words.native_definition: causing death; leading to disaster
words.core_concept: the one stroke after which nothing can be redone – 这一下过后，什么都补不回来了
words.core_image: 那一刀下去就没有第二次机会，别的伤都还能治
semantic_expansions: 致命的：这一下过后补不回来
毁灭性的：同样不可挽回，用在局面上
命中注定的：早已说定、避不开的
words.recall_hint: fatum（定数）+ -al → 关乎定数、补不回来

words.root_logic: Fata（司命女神）→ 古法语 fae（有法力的女子）+ -ry → 小精灵
words.origin: 古法语 faerie（法术、精灵之境）← fae ← 拉丁语 Fata（司命三女神）← fatum
words.native_definition: a small imaginary being with magic powers
words.core_concept: the small being said to hold sway over how things turn out – 传说能左右事情走向的那个小小者
words.core_image: 书里画着一个巴掌大的身影，背后两片薄翅
examples: She read a fairy tale aloud.
semantic_expansions: 仙女/小精灵：传说能左右事情走向的那个小小者
words.recall_hint: Fata（司命女神）→ fae（有法力者）→ 小精灵

words.root_logic: im-（in- 向内）+ ploy（折叠）→ implicare（把人卷进事里）→ 雇用、使用
words.origin: 古法语 employer ← 拉丁语 implicare（卷入、缠进）← in＋plicare（折叠）
words.native_definition: to pay someone to work; to make use of something
words.core_concept: folding a person into the work so they are part of it – 把人折进这摊事里，成为其中一折
words.core_image: 名册上添了一个名字，从此这摊活里就有他一份
semantic_expansions: 雇用：把人折进这摊事里、给他一份
使用：把某物折进做法里派上用场
words.recall_hint: im-（向内）+ ploy（折叠）→ 把人折进事里

words.root_logic: employ（雇用）+ -ee（受事者）→ 被折进这摊活里的那个人
words.origin: 英语 employee，由 employ 加受事后缀 -ee 构成 ← 拉丁语 implicare
words.native_definition: a person who is paid to work for someone else
words.core_concept: the one folded in, who works and draws pay – 被折进来做活、按月领钱的那个
words.core_image: 工牌上印着号码，每月到日子就有一笔钱进账
examples: Every employee gets two weeks off.
semantic_expansions: 雇员/员工：被折进这摊活里、按期领钱的那个人
words.recall_hint: employ（雇用）+ -ee（受事）→ 被折进来做活的人

words.root_logic: employ（雇用）+ -er（施事者）→ 把人折进来的那一方
words.origin: 英语 employer，由 employ 加施事后缀 -er 构成 ← 拉丁语 implicare
words.native_definition: a person or company that pays others to work
words.core_concept: the side that does the folding-in and pays for it – 把人折进来、并为此付钱的那一方
words.core_image: 签字那一栏是公司的印，钱从那边出
examples: Her employer gave her a raise.
The employer must provide safety gear.
semantic_expansions: 雇主/用人单位：把人折进来做活、并为此付钱的那一方
words.recall_hint: employ（雇用）+ -er（施事）→ 把人折进来的那方

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ ploit（折叠）→ explicare（把折的摊开）→ 把用处榨出来 → 利用、开发
words.origin: 古法语 esploitier（施行、获益）← 拉丁语 explicare（展开）← ex＋plicare（折叠）
words.native_definition: to use something fully for gain; to treat someone unfairly for profit
words.core_concept: unfolding a thing to get everything out of it – 把折着的摊开，把里头能取的都取出来
words.core_image: 那张折了几道的纸被完全摊平，背面的字也一并露了出来
examples: They exploit the mine for copper.
semantic_expansions: 利用/开发：把折着的摊开、取尽其中用处
剥削：这种取尽用在人身上
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ ploit（折叠）→ 摊开取尽其用

words.root_logic: ambactus（受派办事的人）→ 受派驻外办事的那个馆
words.origin: 古法语 ambassee ← 意大利语 ambasciata ← 拉丁语 ambactus（受派之人）← 印欧 *ag-（推动、驱使）一支，与 act 同源远亲
words.native_definition: the official office of an ambassador in another country
words.core_concept: the house that stands in for one country inside another – 一国派在别国境内代它办事的那处馆
words.core_image: 门口挂着别国的旗，里头办的是那个国家的事
examples: He works at the British embassy.
semantic_expansions: 大使馆/使节团：一国派驻别国、代它办事的那处馆
words.recall_hint: ambactus（受派办事者）→ 派驻外国的那处馆

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ ag（驱动、称量）→ exagium（称重）→ 试着写出的一篇 → 短文
words.origin: 古法语 essai（尝试、试验）← 晚期拉丁语 exagium（称量）← exigere（ex＋agere 推出、称量）
words.native_definition: a short piece of writing on one subject; an attempt
words.core_concept: the piece written as a weighing-out of one question – 就一个题目称量着写出的那一篇
words.core_image: 题目摆在纸头，底下一段段把想法称量着摆开
examples: She wrote an essay on climate.
It was his first essay at farming.
semantic_expansions: 文章/论文：就一题称量着写出的那一篇
尝试：同一个「试着称量」用作动作
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ ag（称量）→ exagium → 试写的一篇

words.root_logic: examination 的截短 ← examen（秤舌）← ex＋ag（驱出、称量）→ 称量学识的那一场
words.origin: 英语 exam 是 examination 的截短 ← 拉丁语 examen（天平的指针、称量）← exigere
words.native_definition: a formal test of knowledge or ability
words.core_concept: the occasion on which what one knows is weighed – 把人所知放上秤称一遍的那一场
words.core_image: 卷子发下来，会与不会当场就分出轻重
semantic_expansions: 考试/测验：把人所知放上秤称量的那一场
words.recall_hint: examen（秤舌）← ex＋ag（称量）→ 称量学识的一场

words.root_logic: en-（使）+ able（拿得住）→ 使某人拿得住、办得成
words.origin: 英语 enable，由 en-＋able 构成；able ← 拉丁语 habilis ← habere（拿住）
words.native_definition: to make it possible for someone to do something
words.core_concept: putting the thing within reach of a hand that could not hold it before – 让原先拿不住的那只手够得着、握得住
words.core_image: 垫脚的凳子搬来，本来伸手不及的那格就取到了
examples: The grant enabled her to study.
semantic_expansions: 使能够/使有可能：让原先拿不住的手够得着、握得住
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ able（拿得住）→ 使其办得成

words.root_logic: dis-（取消）+ able（拿得住）→ 使拿不住、使用不了
words.origin: 英语 disable，由 dis-＋able 构成；able ← 拉丁语 habilis ← habere（拿住）
words.native_definition: to make someone unable to do something; to switch off a function
words.core_concept: taking away the grip that was there before – 把原先握得住的那份力撤掉
words.core_image: 闸一拉下来，方才还转着的机器立刻停住
examples: The injury disabled his right arm.
semantic_expansions: 使失能/使残疾：把原先握得住的那份力撤掉
停用：把功能撤掉、使它用不了
words.recall_hint: dis-（取消）+ able（拿得住）→ 使拿不住

words.root_logic: en-（使）+ dow（dare 给）→ 把一份给定在某人名下 → 捐赠、赋予
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 endouer ← en-＋古法语 douer ← 拉丁语 dotare（给嫁资）← dos ← dare（给）
words.native_definition: to give money or property to an institution; to give a quality naturally
words.core_concept: handing over a portion for good, not on loan – 交出去的那份是定给的，不是借的
words.core_image: 文书上写明这笔钱此后归学校，不再收回
examples: She is endowed with great patience.
semantic_expansions: 捐赠/资助：把一份定给出去、不再收回
赋予：天生就把某种性质给定在某人身上
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ dow（给）→ 把一份定给出去

words.root_logic: dosis（所给的一份）← didonai/dare（给）→ 一次给下的那个量
words.origin: 法语 dose ← 晚期拉丁语 dosis ← 希腊语 dosis（给予、一份），与拉丁 dare 同出印欧 *do-（给）
words.native_definition: a measured amount of medicine taken at one time
words.core_concept: the one portion measured out to be handed over at a time – 量好、一次交出去的那一份
words.core_image: 药瓶盖里倒到那道刻线，一次就喝这么多
examples: Take one dose every four hours.
He got a high dose of radiation.
semantic_expansions: 剂量/一剂：量好、一次给下的那一份
words.recall_hint: dosis（所给的一份）← 与 dare 同出印欧 *do-（给）

words.root_logic: e-（ex- 出来）+ lite（拣选）→ eligere（挑出来）→ 被挑出的那一小群
words.origin: 法语 élite ← élire（挑选）← 拉丁语 eligere（选出）← ex＋legere（拣选）
words.native_definition: a small group with the most power or skill
words.core_concept: the few picked out of the many and set apart – 从众人里挑出来、单独放一处的那几个
words.core_image: 名单一层层筛下来，最后只剩最上面几个名字
semantic_expansions: 精英/上层集团：从众人里挑出、单独放一处的那几个
words.recall_hint: e-（出来）+ lite（拣选）→ 挑出来的那一小群

words.root_logic: integer（未经触碰的、完整的）→ 一点没缺的 → 全部的
words.origin: 古法语 entier ← 拉丁语 integer（完整的、未动过的）← in-（不）＋tangere（触）
words.native_definition: whole; with no part missing
words.core_concept: the thing still as it came, nothing taken off – 还是原来那一整个，没被取走过任何一块
words.core_image: 整块蛋糕端上来，刀还没碰过它
semantic_expansions: 整个的/全部的/完整的：还是原来那一整个、没被取走任何一块
words.recall_hint: integer（未经触碰的完整）→ 一点没缺的

words.root_logic: en-（使）+ sure（无忧）→ 把事办到没有可担心的余地 → 确保
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 enseurer ← en-＋seur（可靠的）← 拉丁语 securus（无忧的）← se-（无）＋cura（挂心）
words.native_definition: to make certain that something happens
words.core_concept: closing every gap until there is nothing left to worry about – 把每一处漏洞都堵上，没什么可担心了
words.core_image: 门窗一扇扇查过，回头再看一遍才走开
examples: Please ensure the door is locked.
semantic_expansions: 确保/保证：把每处漏洞都堵上、没什么可担心
words.recall_hint: en-（使）+ sure（无忧）→ 办到无可担心

words.root_logic: de-（彻底）+ liver（liberare 使自由）→ 把东西从手里放开交出去 → 递送
words.origin: 古法语 delivrer ← 晚期拉丁语 deliberare（释放、交付）← de＋liberare（使自由）← liber（自由的）
words.native_definition: to take goods to someone; to give a speech; to help at a birth
words.core_concept: letting go of what you held so it passes on – 把攥着的松开，让它转到别处去
words.core_image: 包裹从手里递出去，签完字那人转身就走了
semantic_expansions: 递送：把攥着的松开、让它转到别处
发表：把话从口里放出去
分娩：把胎儿从体内放出来
words.recall_hint: de-（彻底）+ liver（使自由）→ 从手里放开交出

words.root_logic: deliver（递送）+ -y → 递送这件事，或递到的那一批
words.origin: 盎格鲁法语 delivree ← delivrer ← 晚期拉丁语 deliberare ← liber（自由的）
words.native_definition: the act of bringing goods; the way something is said; a birth
words.core_concept: the handing-over itself, and the load handed over – 交出这件事，及交出去的那一批
words.core_image: 清早那车停在门口，一箱箱往下卸
examples: Her delivery of the speech was calm.
semantic_expansions: 投递/交付：把东西交出去这件事及那一批货
分娩：把胎儿放出来这件事
words.recall_hint: deliver（递送）+ -y → 交出这件事及所交之物

words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ play（折叠）→ displicare（把折的展开）→ 摊开给人看
words.origin: 古法语 despleier ← 拉丁语 displicare（展开）← dis＋plicare（折叠）
words.native_definition: to put something where people can see it; a show of something
words.core_concept: unfolding a thing so the whole of it faces out – 把折着的展开，整面朝外露出来
words.core_image: 折成一叠的图纸抖开铺平，整幅一次看全
semantic_expansions: 展示/陈列：把折着的展开、整面朝外给人看
显示：屏幕把内容摊出来给人看
words.recall_hint: dis-（分开）+ play（折叠）→ 把折的展开给人看

words.root_logic: de-（往下）+ gree（gradus 一步）→ 一级一级的那个梯级 → 程度、学位
words.origin: 古法语 degré ← 通俗拉丁语 degradus（阶级）← de＋gradus（一步、级）
words.native_definition: a level or amount on a scale; a qualification from a university
words.core_concept: one notch on a ladder of notches – 一格格刻度里的那一格
words.core_image: 温度计上一道道刻线，水银停在其中一道上
examples: The water is at ninety degrees.
She earned a degree in law.
semantic_expansions: 程度/度数：一格格刻度里的那一格
学位：学业等级里评定到的那一级
words.recall_hint: de-（往下）+ gree（一步）→ 一级级刻度里的那一格

words.root_logic: de-（离开）+ sire（sidus 星）→ 抬头望星而盼 → 渴望
words.origin: 古法语 desirer ← 拉丁语 desiderare（渴望，一说 de＋sidus 从星象盼求）← sidus（星）
words.native_definition: to want something very much
words.core_concept: the eyes lifted to something far off, wanting it down – 抬头望着远处那样东西，盼它落到手里
words.core_image: 夜里抬头望着那颗星看了很久，心里空着一处
semantic_expansions: 渴望/想要：抬头望着远处那样、盼它落到手里
欲望：心里那处空着、要拿它来填的劲
words.recall_hint: de-（离开）+ sire（星）→ 望星而盼

words.root_logic: ex-（出去）+ pire（spirare 呼吸）→ 气出去不再回来 → 到期、死
words.origin: 拉丁语 exspirare（呼出、气绝）← ex＋spirare（呼吸）
words.native_definition: to come to an end; to stop being valid; to die
words.core_concept: the last breath going out with none coming back – 最后一口气出去，再没有吸进来的
words.core_image: 胸口起伏一次之后就平了下去，再没抬起来
semantic_expansions: 到期/期满：效力像气一样出去不再回来
去世：最后一口气出去不再吸进
words.recall_hint: ex-（出去）+ pire（呼吸）→ 气出去不再回来

words.root_logic: dis-（分开）+ creet（cernere 筛分）→ 分得清该说不该说 → 谨慎、不外传
words.origin: 古法语 discret ← 拉丁语 discretus（分开的、有分辨的），discernere 的过去分词 ← dis＋cernere（筛分）
words.native_definition: careful not to say or do anything that causes trouble
words.core_concept: the one who sifts what may be said from what may not – 把能说的与不能说的筛开的那种人
words.core_image: 他知道内情，但话到嘴边只挑得出无关的几句
semantic_expansions: 谨慎的/守口的：把能说与不能说筛开的那种
不张扬的：把自己从人眼里筛开、不显出来
words.recall_hint: dis-（分开）+ creet（筛分）→ 分得清该说不该说

words.root_logic: dis-（去掉）+ card（纸牌）→ 把手里那张牌打掉 → 丢弃
words.origin: 英语 discard，由 dis-＋card 构成；card ← 拉丁语 charta（纸）
words.native_definition: to throw away something no longer wanted
words.core_concept: laying a card out of your hand and not taking it back – 把手里那张打出去，不再拿回
words.core_image: 他从手里抽出一张扣到桌边，那张就不算他的了
semantic_expansions: 丢弃/抛弃：把手里那张打出去、不再拿回
打出（牌）：牌戏里这个动作的本义
words.recall_hint: dis-（去掉）+ card（纸牌）→ 把手里那张打掉

words.root_logic: ex-（出来）+ ert（serere 编连）→ exserere（抽出来）→ 把力使出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 exserere（伸出、抽出）← ex＋serere（编连、串接）
words.native_definition: to use strength or influence to make something happen
words.core_concept: drawing the strand out of the weave and putting it to work – 把编在里头的那股抽出来使上
words.core_image: 攥紧的手往外一抽，绳上那股劲全使了出去
semantic_expansions: 运用/施加：把编在里头的那股力抽出来使上
尽力：把自己那股全抽出来使
words.recall_hint: ex-（出来）+ ert（编连）→ 把里头那股抽出来使

words.root_logic: de-（取消）+ fy（fidere 信托）→ 撤回信托、宣告不再服 → 违抗
words.origin: 古法语 defier（挑战、宣告绝交）← 通俗拉丁语 disfidare ← dis＋fidus（可信的）← fidere（信托）
words.native_definition: to refuse to obey; to be impossible to explain
words.core_concept: taking back the trust once pledged and standing against it – 把当初许下的信托撤回，转身站到对面
words.core_image: 他把那份契约推回去，说往后不认这一条
semantic_expansions: 违抗/公然反抗：撤回信托、转身站到对面
使无法：某事顶住了解释，讲不通
words.recall_hint: de-（取消）+ fy（信托）→ 撤回信托、不再服
